descriptions.notStarted: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.
descriptions.inProgress: I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year.  All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!
descriptions.completed: I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to Maple Claws.  In return, she gave me a red #bMaplemas Hat#k that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit!  Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k.  I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards!  I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn #bMaplemas Spirit#k!  If the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!a
